description: Source file implementing the FuchsiaCdmManager class, managing CDM key system connections, storage, and quotas within the media namespace.

classes.name: FuchsiaCdmManager::KeySystemClient
classes.description: Manages individual key system connections, handles data store creation, provisioning fetchers, and error handling.

methods.name: GetDataStoreIdForPath
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a data store ID for a given storage path, setting up provisioning fetchers and key system data stores.

methods.name: CreateCdm
methods.description: Creates and binds a CDM interface, managing storage directory creation and error handling.

methods.name: GetOrCreateKeySystemClient
methods.description: Retrieves an existing key system client or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: CreateKeySystemClient
methods.description: Creates a new key system client, binds it, and registers it in the active clients map.

methods.name: GetStoragePath
methods.description: Generates a storage path based on the key system and origin, using hashed values.

methods.name: OnKeySystemClientError
methods.description: Handles errors and disconnections of key system clients, removing them from active map.
